_comment: Fund manager logos, fetched from each company's own website and approved by the owner on 2026-08-15. Keys are matched case-insensitively against manager_name_en from /api/v1/funds (substring match, longest key wins). A manager with no entry renders a name monogram — never a wrong or invented mark. Mirrored to public/assets/manager-logos.js by scripts/sync-manager-logos.mjs and gated: raster logos must be >= 104px wide (52px mark at 2x). Source domains are recorded so each can be re-verified when a company rebrands.
